title: Maya Chen - straightforward established firm
sourceBasis: Synthetic discovery call modeled on the structure and terminology of the locally stored Circleback demo replay.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: Before we jump in, what name should I put on my notes, and what is the name of your firm?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: I'm Maya Chen, and the firm is Chen Tax & Advisory.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: Where are you calling in from today?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: We're based in Austin, Texas.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: How many total returns do you file in a year, and how does that split between personal and business returns?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: We file 1,240 total returns: 980 personal returns and 260 business returns.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: What do you use for tax software, and is it desktop, cloud, or hosted?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: We use UltraTax on desktop, hosted by Rightworks.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: What do you use for a client portal, practice management, and other supporting software?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: SmartVault is our client portal, Canopy is our practice management, and our other tools are QuickBooks Online, SurePrep, and GruntWorx.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: How many admins, preparers, reviewers, and CPAs are on the team?

turns.speaker: PROSPECT
turns.text: We have 2 admins, 6 preparers, 2 reviewers, and 4 CPAs.

turns.speaker: ROSS
turns.text: For the trial, our minimum commitment is 100 returns, and the price is $40 per return.
